tools.name: corporate-intelligence_registry-record-normalize
tools.description: Normalize supplied company registry fields and legal-name tokens. Missing identifiers stay blank rather than invented. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/corporate-intelligence/registry-record-normalize. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: corporate-intelligence_company-identity-cross-check
tools.description: Compare supplied company records by registry number, LEI, and normalized names. Possible matches are never treated as confirmed. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/corporate-intelligence/company-identity-cross-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: corporate-intelligence_director-history
tools.description: Group supplied director appointments by company into a chronological history without inventing missing dates. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/corporate-intelligence/director-history. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: corporate-intelligence_company-ownership-chain-map
tools.description: Walk supplied parent-child ownership edges into chains. Missing ownership percents are labeled, not invented. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/corporate-intelligence/company-ownership-chain-map. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: corporate-intelligence_name-variant-resolve
tools.description: Group legal, trading, and alias names per company. Similar-only variants stay possible and are not confirmed identity matches. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/corporate-intelligence/name-variant-resolve. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: corporate-intelligence_sanctions-list-change-detect
tools.description: Diff current and previous supplied sanctions entries by normalized name. Optional OFAC fetch can populate the current list when requested. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/corporate-intelligence/sanctions-list-change-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: corporate-intelligence_company-enforcement-history
tools.description: Attach supplied enforcement actions to companies. Possible name matches are listed separately and never confirmed. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/corporate-intelligence/company-enforcement-history. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: corporate-intelligence_public-procurement-exclusion-check
tools.description: Compare companies to a supplied procurement exclusion list. Only exact name or registry matches are confirmed exclusions. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/corporate-intelligence/public-procurement-exclusion-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: corporate-intelligence_network-relationship-analyze
tools.description: Build a relationship graph from supplied directors, ownership edges, and explicit relationships. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/corporate-intelligence/network-relationship-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: corporate-intelligence_investigation-source-citation-package
tools.description: Aggregate registry, ownership, sanctions, enforcement, exclusion, and network summaries with source citations. Uncertain matches stay unconfirmed. Price $0.08 USDC. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "corporate-intelligence" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: corporate-intelligence_company-identity-cross-check, corporate-intelligence_sanctions-list-change-detect, corporate-intelligence_public-procurement-exclusion-check · Private data: corporate-intelligence_registry-record-normalize, corporate-intelligence_company-identity-cross-check · Public sink: corporate-intelligence_registry-record-normalize, corporate-intelligence_company-identity-cross-check, corporate-intelligence_director-history, corporate-intelligence_company-ownership-chain-map, corporate-intelligence_name-variant-resolve, corporate-intelligence_sanctions-list-change-detect, corporate-intelligence_company-enforcement-history, corporate-intelligence_public-procurement-exclusion-check, corporate-intelligence_network-relationship-analyze, corporate-intelligence_investigation-source-citation-package · Destructive: corporate-intelligence_registry-record-normalize, corporate-intelligence_company-identity-cross-check, corporate-intelligence_director-history, corporate-intelligence_company-ownership-chain-map, corporate-intelligence_name-variant-resolve, corporate-intelligence_sanctions-list-change-detect, corporate-intelligence_company-enforcement-history, corporate-intelligence_public-procurement-exclusion-check, corporate-intelligence_network-relationship-analyze, corporate-intelligence_investigation-source-citation-package.
